# New Epics

## Add Position/Dividend or Deposit Breaks Others

When I add a new position in the Open Positions screen, navigating to Sold Positions or Dividend Deposits throws an exception and nothing displays on the screen. This probably has something to do with how we are adding the position using SmartNgRX/SmartSignals. Be sure to use the documentation for SmartNgRX/SmartSignals correctly. This is NOT NgRX. It is a wrapper around NgRX. Do not make NgRX assumptions when trying to fix the issue. There is a similar issue when adding a dividend or deposit ont he Dividend Deposits screen. We add an item and then we navigate to Open Positions or Sold Positions and encounter the same problem.
